title: Commanders to retire No. 44 of HOF RB Riggins

sources.name: ESPN NFL
sources.title: Commanders to retire No. 44 of HOF RB Riggins
sources.description: The Commanders are retiring the No. 44 worn by Hall of Famer and franchise rushing leader John Riggins -- more than 40 years after one of the most famous runs in Super Bowl history.
